{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgS1jY8ryabD4w2EixTgZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountRename.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Rename\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account rename`, which changes only an account's name and writes the updated account row. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account rename |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLet the shop correct the display name of an existing account without touching its code or its transactions.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger account rename <code> <name>` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly two arguments after `rename`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Look up the account by code. An absent code exits 4. This check runs before the name is validated.\n3. Validate the name: 1 to 40 characters, no comma, no newline. An invalid name exits 3 and changes nothing.\n4. Update only the name through the persistence library.\n5. Compute the account's transaction count and balance in integer cents from its stored transactions.\n6. Write the header `account,name,transactions,balance` and the updated row, balance with exactly two decimals.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: look up the account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-003` — write: rename the account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list the account's transactions to count and sum them - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- Only the name changes; the code and transactions are untouched.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n- Money is integer cents at every layer; no floating point.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-rename-success ===\nIntent: Renaming an existing account exits 0, writes the account row with the new name, and a separate read shows the stored name changed.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZRN1\"\nold_name = \"Old Cash Box\"\nnew_name = \"Event Cash Box\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=old_name)\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, new_name)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [code, new_name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]\n    back = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.name == new_name\n=== END AC acct-rename-success ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-only-name ===\nIntent: Rename changes only the name; the account keeps its transaction and the output reports its count and balance derived from the stored amount.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZRN2\"\ncat = \"ZRN2\"\ntxn_id = 910001\ncents = 1250\nnew_name = \"Renamed Account\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=\"Before\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Rename Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=code, category=cat, amount=cents, memo=\"keep\"\n    )\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, new_name)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    expected_balance = f\"{Decimal(cents) / 100:.2f}\"\n    assert rows[1] == [code, new_name, \"1\", expected_balance]\n    txn = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    assert txn is not None\n    assert txn.amount == cents\n    assert txn.account == code\n    assert txn.memo == \"keep\"\n=== END AC acct-rename-only-name ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-absent ===\nIntent: Renaming an account that does not exist exits 4, writes nothing to standard output, and creates no account.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZRNNONE\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, \"Ghost\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC acct-rename-absent ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-invalid-name ===\nIntent: A name that is too long or contains a comma is rejected with exit 3, nothing on standard output, and the stored name is unchanged.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZRN3\"\noriginal = \"Original Name\"\ntoo_long = \"N\" * 41\nwith_comma = \"Left,Right\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=original)\n    for bad in (too_long, with_comma):\n        exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, bad)\n        print(exit_code, out, err)\n        assert exit_code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        back = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n        assert back is not None\n        assert back.name == original\n=== END AC acct-rename-invalid-name ===\n\n=== AC acct-rename-absent-before-invalid ===\nIntent: For an absent code with an invalid name the not-found check runs first, so the exit code is 4 rather than 3.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZRNNONE2\"\ntoo_long = \"N\" * 41\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"rename\", code, too_long)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC acct-rename-absent-before-invalid ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Only the account name may change; the code and transactions are never altered by rename.\n- Persistence is reached only through the generated persistence package.\n- A rejected rename writes nothing to the database.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account delete`, which removes an account that has no transactions. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLet the shop remove an account created in error, while protecting any account that already carries transaction history.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger account delete <code>` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly one argument after `delete`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Look up the account. An absent code exits 4.\n3. List the account's transactions. If any exist, exit 3 and remove nothing.\n4. Delete the account through the persistence library.\n5. Write `deleted` and then the code, one per line.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: look up the account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-004` — write: delete the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list the account's transactions to detect use - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- An account with at least one transaction is never removed.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-delete-success ===\nIntent: Deleting an unused account exits 0, writes the word deleted then the code, and a separate read finds the account gone.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZDL1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=\"Disposable\")\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"deleted\"], [code]]\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC acct-delete-success ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-in-use ===\nIntent: An account that has a transaction is refused with exit 3, and both the account and its transaction remain.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZDL2\"\ncat = \"ZDL2\"\ntxn_id = 920001\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code, name=\"In Use\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=code, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is not None\n=== END AC acct-delete-in-use ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an account that does not exist exits 4 with nothing on standard output.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode = \"ZDLNONE\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n=== END AC acct-delete-absent ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-leaves-others ===\nIntent: Deleting one account removes only that account; a second account created alongside it is still present.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ngone = \"ZDL3\"\nkept = \"ZDL4\"\nkept_name = \"Keeper\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=gone, name=\"Goner\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=kept, name=kept_name)\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", gone)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=gone) is None\n    survivor = db.accounts.get(account=kept)\n    assert survivor is not None\n    assert survivor.name == kept_name\n=== END AC acct-delete-leaves-others ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- An account with transactions is never deleted.\n- Persistence is reached only through the generated persistence package.\n- A rejected delete writes nothing to the database.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Post\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn post`, which validates a new cash transaction in full and stores it with the next transaction id. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, categories, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt (positive) or payment (negative) against an account and category, assigning its id automatically.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require four or five arguments after `post`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Validate the amount with the shared parser: `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero; convert to integer cents with no floating point.\n3. Validate the date as a real Gregorian calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` (February 29 only in leap years).\n4. Validate the memo (0 to 60 characters, no comma, no newline); an omitted memo is stored as the empty string.\n5. Confirm the account and the category exist; either missing exits 3.\n6. Compute the account's balance from its stored transactions and confirm balance plus amount is not below zero.\n7. Assign `txn_id` as one more than the largest stored id, or 1 when no transaction exists.\n8. Only after every check passes, create the row and write the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the new row with the amount at exactly two decimals.\n\nAny failure in steps 2 to 6 exits 3 and writes nothing.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list transactions to compute the balance and the largest id - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create the transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- Amounts are integer cents at every layer.\n- A rejected post changes no stored record.\n- Output uses `\\n` line endings and no quoting.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-success ===\nIntent: Posting a valid transaction exits 0, writes the new row with the next id, and a separate read returns every stored column.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP1\"\ncat = \"ZTP1\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = 4550\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = (max(before) + 1) if before else 1\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, date, memo)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(expected_id), date, acct, cat, amount_text, memo]\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.date == date\n    assert back.account == acct\n    assert back.category == cat\n    assert back.amount == cents\n    assert back.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-first-id ===\nIntent: In an empty transaction table the first posted transaction receives id 1.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP2\"\ncat = \"ZTP2\"\namount_text = \"10.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.transactions.delete_all(min_txn_id=0)\n    assert db.transactions.list() == []\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"First Id\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"First Id\")\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][0] == str(1)\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=1) is not None\n=== END AC txn-post-first-id ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-no-memo ===\nIntent: A transaction posted without a memo writes an empty final memo field and stores an empty memo.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP3\"\ncat = \"ZTP3\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"No Memo\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"No Memo\")\n    before = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = (max(before) + 1) if before else 1\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"5.00\", \"2026-04-03\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows[1]) == 6\n    assert rows[1][5] == \"\"\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.memo == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-post-no-memo ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-negative-covered ===\nIntent: A negative amount is accepted when the account balance stays non-negative, and the output carries a leading minus with two decimals.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP4\"\ncat = \"ZTP4\"\ntxn_id = 930001\nfunded_cents = 5000\nspend_text = \"-12.34\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Spender\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Spend\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=funded_cents, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, spend_text, \"2026-04-02\", \"tape\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][4] == spend_text\n    assert Decimal(rows[1][4]) == Decimal(spend_text)\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-covered ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-negative-balance-rejected ===\nIntent: A post that would leave the account balance below zero exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP5\"\ncat = \"ZTP5\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Broke\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Spend\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-1000.00\", \"2026-04-04\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-balance-rejected ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-reference-rejected ===\nIntent: An unknown category or an unknown account is rejected with exit 3 and nothing is stored.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import account rename <code> <name>` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nLet the shop remove an account created in error, while protecting any account that already carries transaction history.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger account delete <code>` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly one argument after `delete`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Look up the account. An absent code exits 4.\n3. List the account's transactions. If any exist, exit 3 and remove nothing.\n4. Delete the account through the persistence library.\n5. Write `deleted` and then the code, one per line.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: look up the account by code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-004` — write: delete the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list the account's transactions to detect use - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- An account with at least one transaction is never removed.\n- A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC acct-delete-success ===\nIntent: Deleting an unused account exits 0, writes the word deleted then the code, and a separate read finds the account gone.\n\nimport [[\"deleted\"], [code]]\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC acct-delete-success ===\n\n=== AC acct-delete-in-use ===\nIntent: An account that has a transaction is refused txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-05-01\", account=code, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n Transaction Post\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn post`, which validates a new cash transaction in full and stores it with the next transaction id. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes | ledger, accounts, categories, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt (positive) or payment (negative) against an account and category, assigning its id automatically.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require four or five arguments after `post`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Validate the amount with the shared parser: `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero; convert to integer cents with no floating point.\n3. Validate the date as a real Gregorian calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD` (February 29 only in leap years).\n4. Validate the memo (0 to 60 characters, no comma, no newline); an omitted memo is stored as the empty string.\n5. Confirm the account and the category exist; either missing exits 3.\n6. Compute the account's balance from its stored transactions and confirm balance plus amount is not below zero.\n7. Assign `txn_id` as one more than the largest stored id, or 1 when no transaction exists.\n8. Only after every check passes, create the row and write the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the new row with the amount at exactly two decimals.\n\nAny failure in steps 2 to 6 exits 3 and writes nothing.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list transactions to compute the balance and the largest id - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create the transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- Amounts are integer cents at every layer.\n- A rejected post changes no stored record.\n- Output uses `\\n` line endings and no quoting.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-success ===\nIntent: Posting a valid transaction exits 0, writes the new row with the next id, and a separate read returns every stored column.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP1\"\ncat = \"ZTP1\"\namount_text = \"45.50\"\ncents = 4550\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = (max(before) + 1) if before else 1\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, date, memo)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(expected_id), date, acct, cat, amount_text, memo]\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.date == date\n    assert back.account == acct\n    assert back.category == cat\n    assert back.amount == cents\n    assert back.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-post-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-first-id ===\nIntent: In an empty transaction table the first posted transaction receives id 1.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTP2\"\ncat = \"ZTP2\"\namount_text = db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"First Id\")\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount_text, \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n posted\n=== END AC txn-get-after-post ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The command is read-only and never changes a stored record.\n- Persistence is reached only through the generated persistence package.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnAmend.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transaction Amend\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn amend`, which changes only a transaction's amount while keeping every account balance non-negative. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-LedgerCli.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn amend |\n| Consumes | ledger, transactions |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nCorrect the amount of a recorded transaction without altering its date, account, category, or memo.\n\n## Trigger\n\n`ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` invoked from the command line.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly two arguments after `amend`; otherwise raise the shared usage error (exit 2).\n2. Parse the id as an integer (non-integer exits 3) and look up the transaction. An absent id exits 4; this check runs before the amount is validated.\n3. Validate the amount with the shared parser (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`, at most two decimals, never zero) into integer cents. Invalid exits 3.\n4. Compute the owning account's balance from its stored transactions, replace the old amount with the new one, and confirm the result is not below zero. Otherwise exit 3.\n5. Only after every check passes, update the amount and write the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the updated row.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: get the transaction by id - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — read: list the account's transactions to compute the resulting balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — write: change the amount - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Behavior Rules\n\n- Only the amount changes.\n- A rejected amend changes no stored record.\n- Money is integer cents at every layer.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-amend-success ===\nIntent: Amending an amount exits 0, writes the updated row, changes only the amount in storage, and a separate read shows the new cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nacct = \"ZTA1\"\ncat = \"ZTA1\"\ntxn_id = 950001\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nold_cents = 4550\nnew_text = \"54.50\"\nnew_cents = 5450\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Amend Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=date, account=acct, category=cat, amount=old_cents, memo=memo\n    )\n    exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), new_text)\n    print(exit_code, out, err)\n    assert exit_code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert rows[1] == [str(txn_id), date, acct, cat, new_text, memo]\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.amount == new_cents\n    assert back.date == date\n    assert back.account == acct\n    assert back.category == cat\n    assert back.memo == memo\n=== END AC txn-amend-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-amend-absent ===\nIntent: Amending an id that is not stored exits 4, and the not-found check wins over an invalid amount.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    stored = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    absent = (max(stored) + 1000) if stored else 999\n    for amount in (\"5.00\", \"1.234\"):\n        exit_code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(absent), amount)\n        print(amount, exit_code, out, err)\n        assert exit_code == 4\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=absent) is None\n=== END AC txn-amend-absent
